about_the_game:
Story:

You ever wanted to make a lot of money fast? Well, now you can with Drugs and Gambling! In Drugs and Gambling you play as a mobster who has survived the Slimepocalypse. You are using the lack of law to run your casino without any regulations and profit greatly. 

Rig Slots and Roulette Tables:

Rig slots and roulette tables in your favor and steal all of your customers money. If the customers are upset about losing give them drugs that are locally sourced and grown by you personally. 

Sell Your Customers Locally Sourced Drugs:

Keep the customers in constant bliss so before they realize it, they are in debt to you. After they owe you, their debt will skyrocket at a 20% compound interest rate every minute. 

Manage Employees Just Don't Get Screwed Over:

Hire scavengers to find resources so you can make more drugs. Manage your employees respect level if it falls to far, they might start to steal from you. If they do steal from you, you can teach them a lesson and set an example for your other employees by either breaking the thief's legs or straight murdering them. Be careful when murdering employees though if they weren't stealing from you your employees will start to resent you.

So, what are you waiting for get out there and make some money.

content_descriptors.notes: There is implied violence as well as drug use.
